sections.text_helper: Section 31.6.31 "TIM multilevel protection register 1 (TIM_MPR1)" in chapter 31 (Advanced-control timers (TIM1/TIM8)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 1122.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x090
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:16 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 15:14 BK4NM[1:0]: Break mode for tim_oc4n output
This bit must be modified only when CEN=0 in TIM_CR1.
00: Immediate break
01: Delayed 1 break
10: Delayed 2 break
11: Reserved
Note: This bit can not be modified as long as LOCK level 1 has been programmed (LOCK bits
in TIM_BDTR register).
Bits 13:12 BK4M[1:0]: Break mode for tim_oc4 output
This bit must be modified only when CEN=0 in TIM_CR1.
00: Immediate break
01: Delayed 1 break
10: Delayed 2 break
11: Reserved
Note: This bit can not be modified as long as LOCK level 1 has been programmed (LOCK bits
in TIM_BDTR register).
